description: This header file defines a mock class OCIContainerMock for testing the IOCIContainer interface, along with associated notification mock class, for the OCI Container component within a larger project. It includes method mocks for container management operations such as start, stop, get info, and register notifications.

classes.name: OCIContainerMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IOCIContainer interface used for unit testing container management operations.

classes.name: IOCIContainerNotificationMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IOCIContainer::INotification interface for testing container notification callbacks.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks registration of a notification callback with the container system.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Mocks unregistration of a notification callback.

methods.name: GetContainerInfo
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of information about a specific container.

methods.name: GetContainerState
methods.description: Mocks query of a container's current state.

methods.name: StartContainer
methods.description: Mocks starting a container with specified parameters.

methods.name: StartContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Mocks starting a container from a Dobby specification.

methods.name: WakeupContainer
methods.description: Mocks waking up a container from hibernation.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Mocks executing a command inside a container.

methods.name: Annotate
methods.description: Mocks adding an annotation to a container.

methods.name: RemoveAnnotation
methods.description: Mocks removing an annotation from a container.

methods.name: Mount
methods.description: Mocks mounting resources into a container.

methods.name: Unmount
methods.description: Mocks unmounting resources from a container.
